basic_info.description: Perched in one of SF’s most coveted neighborhoods, this immaculate Noe Valley condo blends sleek design with everyday comfort—and those stunning downtown views are just the start.  This spacious, semi-detached 2BD/3BA home lives large with soaring ceilings, natural light, and a floor plan made for entertaining. The main level features open living/dining, hardwood floors, a fireplace, full bath, and a remodeled chef’s kitchen with high-end appliances and a showstopping stainless steel waterfall-edge counter.  Upstairs, the luxe primary suite boasts a spa-like bath and custom closets, while the second bedroom makes a perfect guest space or home office. A second full bath, laundry room, and bonus storage complete the level.  Enjoy private balconies with skyline views, secured garage parking, and massive private storage in this quiet corner unit in a well-maintained 2-unit building—just steps from Noe’s best shops, cafés, and charm.
